### GET `/v1/endpoints/{endpointId}/secrets`

**List signing secret metadata**

Metadata only. No response on this route can contain a plaintext secret - the response type has no field it could occupy. A secret is shown exactly once, when it is created.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

### POST `/v1/endpoints/{endpointId}/secrets/rotate`

**Issue a new signing secret, keeping the old one valid**

The new secret becomes active immediately and the current ones keep signing until `overlap_seconds` (default 86400) elapses. During that window every delivery carries one `v1=` signature per active secret and a consumer that verifies with either one succeeds, so consumers can be rolled without dropping a delivery. The plaintext is in this response and nowhere else, ever.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `endpointId` | path | string | yes |  |  |

#### Request body

`application/json`, required - [RotateSecretDto](./schemas.md#rotatesecretdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `overlap_seconds` | number | no | 0 to 2592000; default `86400` | How long the CURRENT secrets keep signing alongside the new one. Every active secret produces its own `v1=` component in Webhook-Signature and a consumer that matches any one of them verifies, so this is the window in which consumers can be rolled. 0 stops the old secrets immediately - use it for a leak, not for a routine rotation. |

#### Responses

**200 OK** - [RotatedSecretDto](./schemas.md#rotatedsecretdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `endpoint_id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `version` | number | yes |  | Monotonic per endpoint. Highest version is the newest. |
| `active` | boolean | yes |  | Whether this secret currently signs deliveries: the stored `active` flag AND an `expires_at` that has not passed. An expired row reads false here before any sweep has flipped the column. |
| `expires_at` | string \| null | yes |  | When this secret stops signing. |
| `rotated_at` | string \| null | yes |  | When a rotation superseded it. |
| `created_at` | string | yes |  |  |
| `secret` | string | yes |  | The plaintext secret. RETURNED EXACTLY ONCE, in this response. It is encrypted at rest with a key this API does not hand out and is never included in any other response, log line or audit entry. If it is lost, rotate again. |
| `previous_secrets_expire_at` | string \| null | yes |  | The LAST moment any previously issued secret still signs - the maximum over every version in `overlapping_versions`, not just the ones this rotation moved. Null when no prior secret is signing any more (a rotation with `overlap_seconds: 0`, or the first secret on an endpoint). Consumers must accept both old and new until this passes. |
| `overlapping_versions` | number[] | yes |  | EVERY prior version that still signs after this rotation, newest first - including versions whose own expiry this rotation did not move, because they are still emitting a `v1=` component and a consumer rolling its secrets off this list must know about them. |

### DELETE `/v1/endpoints/{endpointId}/secrets/{secretId}`

**Stop one secret signing**

Refused when it is the only secret still signing for a live endpoint: that state makes every delivery fail closed rather than go out unsigned. To retire a leaked secret immediately, rotate with `overlap_seconds: 0`.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).
